projects.name: IMAGE CAPTIONING
projects.summary: Given any real-world image, this project generates an appropriate caption using Machine Learning/Deep Learning. Model is trained on the Flickr8k dataset. For training, Images were encoded into a vector using the Resnet model pre-trained on imagenet dataset, Captions were encoded using LSTM layers and both the inputs were fed to a feed-forward Neural Network to train the model to predict new captions using supervised learning.

projects.name: IMDB Review Sentiment Analysis
projects.summary: Implemented multiple CNN-LSTM based neural networks. Achieved maximum accuracies for the network architecture which used a CNN-LSTM with combined kernels from multiple branches and other architecture that used a CNN-LSTM neural network with a residual connection. It is trained on the IMDB movie reviews dataset and achieved maximum accuracy of 89.39%.

projects.name: Face Detection and Recognition
projects.summary: This program uses the OpenCV library for face detection and recognition in a live video stream. This program draws a rectangle over a detected face and displays the name of the person if the program has been already trained for the face of that person otherwise 'random' is displayed instead of any person name.

projects.name: Dominant Color Extraction Using K-Means
projects.summary: Used the KMeans algorithm to find the most dominant colors of a given image and created a new image with these dominant colors.

projects.name: Emoji Prediction using LSTM
projects.summary: Implementation of a basic emoji predictor using stacked LSTM on a small dataset.
